hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A hook for item-trading pools where every swap pays a buy or sell fee in a designated base token (₱), collected via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and stored as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager. Pool creation is admin-gated (one pool per registered item token); accrued fees are distributed to a FeeSplitter contract via a permissionless flush.
